scope: Durable legacy adoption on a disposable pinned Supabase PostgreSQL container: healthy run, adopter SIGKILL after database-started and after HBA-completion checkpoints, pending-journal recovery, exact stop and replay refusal. Quiescence of legacy host clients remains an explicit operational assumption; raw legacy writers are not fenced. Retained installation untouched.

host headroom checked before bounded probe

healthy: adoption completed and intent consumed
healthy: generation initialized exactly once
healthy: generation pin equals the intent generation
healthy: checkpoints distinguish all durable phases
healthy: source database is stopped again by exact identity
healthy: completed adoption refuses replay without new INIT
